flow.title: CARE FLOW
flow.newPatient: New patient: scheduling → medical history → labs 48h before → consultation → comprehensive plan.
flow.followUp: Follow-up: symptom evaluation, lab review, adjustments, and monthly goals.
flow.policies: Policies: rescheduling >12h, payment before consultation, no prescriptions without consultation.
flow.scriptText: Hello, this is from the doctor's office. Your appointment is confirmed for tomorrow. Please bring your lab results and arrive 10 minutes early.

approach.desc1: Focus on root causes, biomarkers, and personalized plans. We analyze your unique biochemistry to understand what triggers your symptoms. We combine therapeutic nutrition, hormonal optimization, evidence-based supplementation, and lifestyle adjustments to restore your body's balance.
approach.desc2: Comprehensive view considering your complete history, family context, psychosocial factors, and life goals. We make informed decisions considering not only your biology but also your lifestyle, beliefs, and preferences. Continuity of care with personalized follow-up.
approach.desc3: Clear, achievable goals with monthly or bi-weekly review. Secure clinical documentation in digital records. Progressive adjustments based on your evolution, without rigid protocols. Direct communication to resolve doubts. We accompany you in every step toward your best version.

services.title: Services
services.subtitle: Clear and scalable options according to your needs.
services.desc1: In-depth 60–90 minute consultation. Comprehensive medical history review, integral lab analysis from a functional perspective, root cause identification, and personalized written plan delivered within 24 hours.
services.desc2: Progress evaluation, personalized nutritional adjustments, hormonal optimization if needed, supplementation review, medical treatment management, and establishment of achievable monthly goals.
services.desc3: Ideal for complex cases, intensive protocol initiation, significant hormonal changes, or when close monitoring is required. More frequent adjustments for optimal results.
services.desc4: Detailed functional reading of your laboratory results. Biomarker explanation, pattern and trend identification. Recommendations based on optimal values, not just normal ranges. Educational session included.
services.desc5: Consultations in the comfort of your home in San Pedro and Monterrey. Ideal for patients with limited mobility, elderly adults, or those who prefer private care. Availability according to area and schedule.
services.desc6: VIP continuous support with priority attention. Direct WhatsApp access for quick consultations. Metric tracking and progress monitoring with monthly report. Discounts at partner laboratories. Prescription renewals without additional consultation.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Answer your questions before scheduling your consultation.
faq.a1: No. This service does not replace emergency or hospital care. In case of medical emergency, go to the nearest hospital or call 911.
faq.q2: Can I request a prescription without consultation?
faq.a2: Prescriptions are not sent without prior consultation due to medical and legal responsibility. We need to evaluate your current condition before prescribing any treatment.
faq.a3: Rescheduling allowed with more than 12 hours notice. Payment required before consultation. No refunds, only credit for future consultation in cases of proven medical emergency.
faq.a4: In a secure digital platform with data encryption. Access restricted only to the treating physician. Compliance with the Federal Law on Protection of Personal Data of Mexico.
